author: Murphh
body:
We had problems today with the scrim servers. 
{tag=89f514e1f0f549778ddc77ef030a8b46}   
{tag=42b105207c51425292d98b65df108b12}

So, we had organized a scrim between New Dawn and HOME.  When it was time to have scrim, the scrim servers were down...for like an hour!

In the meanwhile, we used the Community01 server. We just had a megascrim instead and everyone was happy. Then when that server ended its rotations, it kicked us from that server.  Well, scrim servers were down still, so we joined the Community03 server.

At this point, one Map Dev rank, one Media rank, and one Ref rank (all from Apollo) were already on the Community03 server before we got there. We asked if we could do our scrim or a megascrim because the scrim servers were down. They said no because it's the community server and not a scrim server.

We asked again and they said no, then I believe the Map Dev cycled all the maps and the server went offline.

So, we were unable to have either a scrim and megascrim. We had at least 20 players that were disappointed.

What is a better solution in the future, besides joining the public servers (destroy/mix)?  Especially if you are trying to keep the competitive team scene alive?

And what happened to the weekly megascrims hosted by avicus staff?
